source_entity: Securities Trade / Security Trading Snapshot / Index Constituent Snapshot
source_attribute: Security Symbol Code / Index Code
atomic_column: security_symbol_code / index_code

etl_logic: JOIN security_trading_snapshot ON security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND securities_trade.security_symbol_code IN (security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code) [dedup bản ghi cuối phiên mỗi (trading_dt, isin_code): ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC) = 1 AND security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10')] INNER JOIN index_constituent_snapshot ON index_constituent_snapshot.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol AND index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND index_constituent_snapshot.index_code IN ('HNX','HOSE','30','HNX30','100') AND SUBSTR(securities_trade.sell_account_nbr, 4, 1) IN ('P','E','A') AND securities_trade.board_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8') → SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) GROUP BY securities_trade.trade_dt, index_constituent_snapshot.index_code
source_entity: Securities Trade / Security Trading Snapshot / Index Constituent Snapshot
source_attribute: Execution Value / Board Type Code / Buy or Sell Account Number / Index Code
atomic_column: execution_val / board_tp_code / buy_account_nbr or sell_account_nbr / index_code
